parent_objective: design calibrated pair expansion after M1547 pair bottleneck
blocked_by: M1547 accepted pair count below threshold
M1547 accepted source-family edge count is one
terminal-boundary history effects are null on the narrow pair subset
supersedes: direct calibrated intervention repair inside the closed fresh-ambiguity branch

public_gates: M1549 must design pair expansion before another intervention implementation
M1549 must keep calibrated pairability as a first-class source-generation objective
M1549 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M1549 must block materialization, training, PPO, promotion, and private holdout

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a new no-training branch to expand calibrated measured pair coverage after M1547 pair-narrow null result
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation smoke, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design does not address pair diversity directly
stop if design routes directly to materialization or training
stop if design weakens history-positive thresholds to pass M1547
stop if design continues the closed paper_route_fresh_ambiguity_source_mining branch
fallback_plan: route to implementation only if pairability and source-diversity gates are explicit
pivot to broader task generation if pair expansion cannot be specified without overfitting to M1547
stop terminal-boundary materialization if pair-expanded intervention remains null
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1548 opens a new calibrated pair-expansion branch

admission_evidence: M1548 closed the previous branch and promoted to calibrated pair expansion
allowed_updates: M1549 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if the design admits it
next_stage_criteria: pair-expansion objective and caps are explicit
source-diversity and pair-diversity gates are explicit
history/control gates remain unchanged or stricter

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1549 is a design milestone and cannot claim history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: planned reset, zero-current, zero-action, and delayed controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: future calibrated pair-expanded public smoke only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If pair expansion remains narrow or null, record the branch result and stop or pivot rather than lowering thresholds.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A pair-expansion design can address the M1547 bottleneck by making calibrated matched-pair diversity the source objective before any further terminal-boundary interventions.
success_criteria: design specifies calibrated pairability metrics and caps
design specifies source-family edge, pair count, and max-share gates
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
design changes actor inputs or weakens history-positive standards
decision_rule: M1549 passes if it defines a no-training calibrated pair-expansion plan with explicit pair-diversity and history/control gates.
